sloka: ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः ।समर्थो सहितौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परन्तपौ ।। ५.६७.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: mamaiva duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ ।samartho sahitau yanmāṁ nāvekṣete parantapau ।। 5.67.24 ।।।।

translations.english: I spoke to her once again: "Lady, I swear to you by truth, Rama is turned away from all but grief for you.
